warnings: Axes: x = 1-2-3-4 at 3.00 + 3.00 + 2.50 (8.50); y = A-B-C at 3.50 + 3.00 (6.50). Origin A1. The same main chains print on S-01, S-02, S-03, S-04, A-08 (x) and A-09 (y). Vector CAD PDF with no text layer — every value read off the rendered page; positions cross-checked against the PDF vector geometry of S-01/S-02 (56.7 pt per metre at 1:50).

Dummies with printed positions: y A' -1.60 (GS slab edge, S-01/S-02), A'' -1.00 and C' 7.50 (1.00 roof overhangs, S-04), A''' 1.40 and B' 5.30 (beam lines, S-01/S-02/S-03), A'''' 1.50 (A-10 stair plan, 2.00 from B), A''''' 1.75 (S-04 chain and TRUSS T1 apex); x 1' -1.00 and 4' 9.50 (S-04 overhangs), 3' 7.50 (A-10, 1.00 from grid 4).

Scaled dummies (section 4 span amendment 2026-08-29): the three small F1,C1 post footings on S-01 sit off the column grid and no sheet prints their x position. 2' 3.20, 2''' 5.35 and 2'''' 5.80 were measured from the S-01 vector geometry against grids 2 and 3 (footing box centres) and are flagged per line (confidence 0.80, scaled_from_grid). 2'' 4.25 is the valley/cross-ridge junction on S-04, also unprinted (vector 4.19-4.34, geometric 4.25 from the printed levels), flagged the same way. Their y positions are NOT scaled: they land exactly (to the millimetre in the vector data) on the printed 1.00 overhang lines A'' and C'.

z: two different ridges print the same label ระดับหลังอกไก่ (+6.87 cross gable over bay 3-4, +7.92 main ridge on grid 2), so those two ids carry the printed value as well; every other z id is the printed label alone. @6.52 is an unlabelled tick (TRUSS T1, 0.35 below the +6.87 ridge).

ระดับดินเดิม (S-05 footing details) and ระดับฝ้าเพดาน (A-08) print no value — kept as levels with level_m null. The footing depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the footing top, footing thickness, 0.05 lean concrete, 0.05 sand) stay on the footing elements (S-05 file), not as z ticks.

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-06 plus A-08/A-09 (building sections, for levels) and A-10 (timber stair detail: its plan chains are anchored to grids 3/4 and B and became lines; its section dimensions carry no grid marker or level label and are in unassigned_dimensions). The other architectural/MEP sheets (A-01..A-07, A-11, A-12, E-01..E-02, SN-01..SN-03) were not dimension-swept in this op04 (pass2-only) run. S-05 and S-06 print only member-internal dimensions (footing/section sizes, slab thicknesses), which stay on their elements.
